I’ll commit to 15 tons this month, so all five of us have now explicitly accepted that allocation.

Jack, I also support your 7-ton limit if next month starts at 50. But that would leave 15 tons, and another weak replenishment would give us just 30 the following month. Let’s agree that whenever the stock differs from 100 or 50, we negotiate new whole-ton limits before choosing, with total catches always leaving at least 5 tons.

We should also review whether these higher catches actually improve our long-run income rather than treating the extra money this month as proof. Luke, Emma, and Kate—do you accept Jack’s 7-ton contingency and that stock-dependent approach?
